title: Discountable Total of a Fleet Invoice by Payment Method — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Discountable total — Service Accounts and Repair Orders fleet invoices.** The discountable total follows how the invoice was paid and the unit's maintenance record in the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans records.

| Latest payment on the invoice made by | Unit carries an active Kessler Care maintenance plan | Discountable total |
|---|---|---|
| Credit card | Either | the customer-pay labor charges less the credits on the invoice; parts earn no discount |
| ACH or check | Yes | the customer-pay labor and parts charges plus the shop supplies fee, less the credits on the invoice |
| ACH or check | No | the customer-pay labor and parts charges less the credits on the invoice |

**Terms.** The credits on the invoice are its comeback, estimate overage and goodwill credits. The unit is the vehicle on the invoice's labor charges. The shop supplies fee is the one charged on the invoice's repair order.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Labor 900.00, parts 300.00, shop supplies fee 35.00, a comeback credit of 120.00:
- paid by credit card — 780.00;
- paid by check, unit with an active plan — 1115.00;
- paid by ACH, unit without a plan — 1080.00.
